finding.summary: The served dispatcher has a reachable extra required-value gate that can suppress a schema-valid model-selected tool call. Other reviewed paths show genuine model use; some invariant coverage remains inconclusive.

decisions.summary: Served action turns obtain genuine model results; the response slot is derived from the resulting model content.
The full trusted-instruction projection through all records-lane deciding calls was not established in this bounded review.
The inspected action reply-check path supplies feedback for a subsequent model turn; no host semantic answer-selection gate was established.
No host-derived value or post-model scorer-slot rewrite was established on the inspected response path.
The reachable action result is model-authored; no closed answer-family compiler controlling the served response was established.
The reported-call list is tied to executor observations, but the complete executor reporting implementation was not established here.

The host treats required empty strings as unfilled independent of schema constraints, then blocks the selected call before endpoint execution; a schema permitting an empty string therefore loses an available capability.
The inspected changed routing logic depends on current request text and available tools, with no evaluation-identity input affecting the served result.
